title: See where risk hides.
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
## Be proactive, not reactive.


Just 1 in 6 decision-makers treat indirect tax as a standing board item. When enterprises aren't sure they can defend an outcome at audit, they play it safe at transaction — and hold their own growth back.


## Maintain compliance at the transaction level.


Your tax engine should support your business strategy, not the other way around. See how we scale with global businesses to provide continuous compliance in real time, at the point of transaction.


## See how leading enterprises do business.


We're trusted by 60%+ of the Fortune 500, including brands like Siemens, Ford, and Microsoft. Come see why they trust us to help close the Compliance Confidence Gap™.
